notes.title: News Update
notes.notes:
Hello Gamers, 

You may notice later today or tomorrow that there are achievements and leader-board associated with the game. 

We are testing them for the next release. You will be able to see them because they have to be in the system, even for testing. You will not be able to work towards achieving them yet, until next release.

Also, a YouTube tutorial is in the making which explains few things about the game, and also talks about the future of the game.

Thank you for playing the game.

Makke on behalf of Makketron LLC

notes.title: Pre-Release Date Change
notes.notes:
Hello steam members, 

We are pleased to announce that the game will be pre-released on the 23rd of January, at 10 p.m.

That is 3 days from now!

Best luck.

notes.title: Hello Steam community
notes.notes:
On the behalf of Makketron LLC, I hope you enjoy this game.

Please feel free to post your ideas on how to improve the game. We will add your name in the "Credits" section of the game if it goes through!

We are working on adding the following features in the next release
  * Difficulty settings
  * Stats and Achievements (Your input on awesome achievements are welcomed)

After that, hopefully there will be enough players to help us with beta testing for multiplayer.

Stay tuned for updates!
